  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/106017343/v4.3.3</id>
    <updated>2026-07-16T11:55:08Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/releases/tag/v4.3.3"/>
    <title>v4.3.3</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Support <code>--watch --poll[=ms]</code> in <code>@tailwindcss/cli</code> when filesystem events are unreliable or unavailable (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20297" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20297/hovercard">#20297</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: match arbitrary hex colors against theme colors case-insensitively (e.g. <code>bg-[#fff]</code> and <code>bg-[#FFF]</code> → <code>bg-white</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20298" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20298/hovercard">#20298</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent Preflight from overriding Firefox's native <code>iframe:focus-visible</code> outline styles (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20292" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20292/hovercard">#20292</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>theme('colors.foo')</code> in JS plugins resolves correctly when both <code>--color-foo</code> and <code>--color-foo-bar</code> exist (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20299" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20299/hovercard">#20299</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure fractional opacity modifiers work with named shadow sizes like <code>shadow-sm/12.5</code>, <code>text-shadow-sm/12.5</code>, <code>drop-shadow-sm/12.5</code>, and <code>inset-shadow-sm/12.5</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20302" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20302/hovercard">#20302</a>)</li>
<li>Parse selectors like <code>[data-foo]div</code> as two selectors instead of one (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20303" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20303/hovercard">#20303</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>@tailwindcss/postcss</code> rebuilds when a preprocessor like Sass changes the input CSS without changing the input file on disk (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20310" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20310/hovercard">#20310</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure CSS nesting is handled even when Lightning CSS isn't run, such as in <code>@tailwindcss/browser</code> and Tailwind Play (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20124" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20124/hovercard">#20124</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent achromatic theme colors from shifting hue when mixed in polar color spaces like <code>oklch</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20314" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20314/hovercard">#20314</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>--spacing(0)</code> is optimized to <code>0px</code> instead of <code>0</code> so it remains a <code>&lt;length&gt;</code> when used in <code>calc(…)</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20319" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20319/hovercard">#20319</a>)</li>
<li>Load <code>@parcel/watcher</code> only when needed in <code>@tailwindcss/cli --watch</code> mode, so one-off builds and <code>--watch --poll</code> work when <code>@parcel/watcher</code> can't be loaded (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20325" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20325/hovercard">#20325</a>)</li>
<li>Use explicit platform fonts instead of <code>system-ui</code> and <code>ui-sans-serif</code> so CJK text respects the page's <code>lang</code> attribute on Windows (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20318" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20318/hovercard">#20318</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent <code>@tailwindcss/upgrade</code> from rewriting ignored files when run from a subdirectory (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20329" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20329/hovercard">#20329</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure earlier <code>@source</code> rules pointing to nested files are scanned when later <code>@source</code> rules point to files in parent folders (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20335" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20335/hovercard">#20335</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> from triggering full page reloads when scanned files are processed by Vite but haven't been loaded as modules yet (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20336" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20336/hovercard">#20336</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/106017343/v4.3.2</id>
    <updated>2026-06-29T14:21:45Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/releases/tag/v4.3.2"/>
    <title>v4.3.2</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Support bare spacing values for <code>auto-rows-*</code> and <code>auto-cols-*</code> utilities (e.g. <code>auto-rows-12</code> and <code>auto-cols-16</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20229" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20229/hovercard">#20229</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent <code>@tailwindcss/cli</code> in <code>--watch</code> mode from crashing on Windows when <code>@source</code> points to a directory that doesn't exist (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20242" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20242/hovercard">#20242</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> from crashing in Deno v2.8.x when <code>context.parentURL</code> is not a valid URL (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20245" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20245/hovercard">#20245</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>@tailwindcss/cli</code> in <code>--watch</code> mode rebuilds when the input CSS file changes in an ignored directory (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20246" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20246/hovercard">#20246</a>)</li>
<li>Allow <code>@variant</code> rules used in <code>addBase(…)</code> to use custom variants defined later (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20247" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20247/hovercard">#20247</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> from crashing during HMR when scanned files or directories are deleted (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20259" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20259/hovercard">#20259</a>)</li>
<li>Generate <code>font-size</code> instead of <code>color</code> declarations for <code>text-[--spacing(…)]</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20260" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20260/hovercard">#20260</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent <code>@source</code> patterns from scanning unrelated sibling files and folders (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20263" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20263/hovercard">#20263</a>)</li>
<li>Extract class candidates adjacent to Template Toolkit delimiters like <code>%]…[%</code> in <code>.tt</code>, <code>.tt2</code>, and <code>.tx</code> files (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20269" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20269/hovercard">#20269</a>)</li>
<li>Extract class candidates from conditional Maud syntax like <code>p.text-black[condition]</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20269" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20269/hovercard">#20269</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent <code>@position-try</code> rules from triggering unknown at-rule warnings when optimizing CSS (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20277" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20277/hovercard">#20277</a>)</li>
<li>Support class suggestions for named opacity modifiers from <code>--opacity</code> theme values (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20287" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20287/hovercard">#20287</a>)</li>
<li>Prevent type errors in <code>@tailwindcss/postcss</code> when used with newer PostCSS patch releases (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20289" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20289/hovercard">#20289</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/106017343/v4.3.1</id>
    <updated>2026-06-12T17:50:58Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/releases/tag/v4.3.1"/>
    <title>v4.3.1</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Added</h3>
<ul>
<li>Add <code>--silent</code> option to suppress output in <code>@tailwindcss/cli</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20100" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20100/hovercard">#20100</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Remove deprecation warnings by using <code>Module#registerHooks</code> instead of <code>Module#register</code> on Node 26+ (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20028" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20028/hovercard">#20028</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: don't crash when plugin utilities throw for unsupported values (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20052" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20052/hovercard">#20052</a>)</li>
<li>Allow <code>@apply</code> to be used with CSS mixins (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19427" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19427/hovercard">#19427</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>not-*</code> correctly negates <code>@container</code> queries, including <code>style(…)</code> queries (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20059" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20059/hovercard">#20059</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>drop-shadow-*</code> color utilities work with custom shadow values containing <code>calc(…)</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20080" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20080/hovercard">#20080</a>)</li>
<li>Fix 'Sourcemap is likely to be incorrect' warnings when using <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20103" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20103/hovercard">#20103</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>@tailwindcss/webpack</code> can be installed in Rspack projects without requiring <code>webpack</code> as a peer dependency (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20027" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20027/hovercard">#20027</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: don't suggest invalid <code>calc(…)</code> expressions (e.g. <code>px-[calc(1rem+0px)]</code> → <code>px-[calc(1rem+0)]</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20127" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20127/hovercard">#20127</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: avoid suggesting large spacing-scale values for arbitrary lengths (e.g. <code>left-[99999px]</code> → <code>left-[99999px]</code>, not <code>left-24999.75</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20130" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20130/hovercard">#20130</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>@tailwindcss/cli</code> in <code>--watch</code> mode recovers when a tracked dependency is deleted and restored (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20137" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20137/hovercard">#20137</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure standalone <code>@tailwindcss/cli</code> binaries are ignored when scanning for class candidates (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20139" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20139/hovercard">#20139</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure class candidates are extracted from Twig <code>addClass(…)</code> and <code>removeClass(…)</code> calls (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20198" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20198/hovercard">#20198</a>)</li>
<li>Don't crash in the Ruby or Vue preprocessors when scanning files containing invalid UTF-8 bytes (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19588" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19588/hovercard">#19588</a>)</li>
<li>Allow <code>@variant</code> to be used inside <code>addBase</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19480" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19480/hovercard">#19480</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>@source</code> globs with symlinks are preserved (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20203" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20203/hovercard">#20203</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure later <code>@source</code> rules can re-include files excluded by earlier <code>@source not</code> rules (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20203" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20203/hovercard">#20203</a>)</li>
<li>Upgrade: don't migrate empty class rules to invalid <code>@utility</code> rules (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20205" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20205/hovercard">#20205</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure transitions between <code>inset-shadow-none</code> and other inset shadows work correctly (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20208" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20208/hovercard">#20208</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure explicitly referenced <code>@source</code> directories are scanned even when ignored by git (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20214" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20214/hovercard">#20214</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>@source</code> globs ending in <code>**/*</code> preserve dynamic path segments to avoid scanning too many files (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20217" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20217/hovercard">#20217</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: don't fold <code>calc(…)</code> divisions when the result would require high precision (e.g. <code>w-[calc(100%/3.5)]</code> → <code>w-[calc(100%/3.5)]</code>, not <code>w-[28.571428571428573%]</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20221" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20221/hovercard">#20221</a>)</li>
<li>Serve ESM type declarations to ESM importers of <code>@tailwindcss/postcss</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20228" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20228/hovercard">#20228</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Changed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Generate <code>0</code> instead of <code>calc(var(--spacing) * 0)</code> for spacing utilities like <code>m-0</code> and <code>left-0</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20196" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20196/hovercard">#20196</a>)</li>
<li>Generate <code>var(--spacing)</code> instead of <code>calc(var(--spacing) * 1)</code> for spacing utilities like <code>m-1</code> and <code>left-1</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20196" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20196/hovercard">#20196</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/106017343/v4.3.0</id>
    <updated>2026-05-08T20:17:25Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/releases/tag/v4.3.0"/>
    <title>v4.3.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Added</h3>
<ul>
<li>Add <code>@container-size</code> utility (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/18901" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/18901/hovercard">#18901</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>scrollbar-{auto,thin,none}</code> utilities for <code>scrollbar-width</code>, and <code>scrollbar-thumb-*</code> / <code>scrollbar-track-*</code> color utilities for <code>scrollbar-color</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19981" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19981/hovercard">#19981</a>, <a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20019" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20019/hovercard">#20019</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>scrollbar-gutter-*</code> utilities (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20018" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20018/hovercard">#20018</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>zoom-*</code> utilities (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20020" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20020/hovercard">#20020</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>tab-*</code> utilities (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20022" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20022/hovercard">#20022</a>)</li>
<li>Allow using <code>@variant</code> with stacked variants (e.g. <code>@variant hover:focus { … }</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19996" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19996/hovercard">#19996</a>)</li>
<li>Allow using <code>@variant</code> with compound variants (e.g. <code>@variant hover, focus { … }</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19996" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19996/hovercard">#19996</a>)</li>
<li>Support <code>--default(…)</code> in <code>--value(…)</code> and <code>--modifier(…)</code> for functional <code>@utility</code> definitions (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19989" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19989/hovercard">#19989</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Ensure <code>@plugin</code> resolves package JavaScript entries instead of browser CSS entries when using <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19949" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19949/hovercard">#19949</a>)</li>
<li>Fix relative <code>@import</code> and <code>@plugin</code> paths resolving from the wrong directory when using <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19965" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19965/hovercard">#19965</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure CSS files containing <code>@variant</code> are processed by <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19966" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19966/hovercard">#19966</a>)</li>
<li>Resolve imports relative to <code>base</code> when <code>result.opts.from</code> is not provided when using <code>@tailwindcss/postcss</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19980" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19980/hovercard">#19980</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: preserve significant <code>_</code> whitespace in arbitrary values (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19986" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19986/hovercard">#19986</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: add parentheses when removing whitespace from arbitrary values would hurt readability (e.g. <code>w-[calc(100%---spacing(60))]</code> → <code>w-[calc(100%-(--spacing(60)))]</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19986" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19986/hovercard">#19986</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: preserve the original unit in arbitrary values instead of normalizing to base units (e.g. <code>-mt-[20in]</code> → <code>mt-[-20in]</code>, not <code>mt-[-1920px]</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19988" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19988/hovercard">#19988</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: migrate arbitrary <code>:has()</code> variants from <code>[&amp;:has(…)]</code> to <code>has-[…]</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19991" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19991/hovercard">#19991</a>)</li>
<li>Upgrade: don’t migrate inline <code>style</code> attributes (e.g. <code>style="flex-grow: 1"</code> → <code>style="flex-grow: 1"</code>, not <code>style="grow: 1"</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19918" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19918/hovercard">#19918</a>)</li>
<li>Allow multiple <code>@utility</code> definitions with the same name but different value types (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19777" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19777/hovercard">#19777</a>)</li>
<li>Export missing <code>PluginWithConfig</code> type from <code>tailwindcss/plugin</code> to fix errors when inferring plugin config types (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19707" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19707/hovercard">#19707</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>start</code> and <code>end</code> legacy utilities without values do not generate CSS (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20003" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20003/hovercard">#20003</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure <code>--value(…)</code> is required in functional <code>@utility</code> definitions (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20005" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20005/hovercard">#20005</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: preserve required whitespace around operators in negated arbitrary values (e.g. <code>-left-[(var(--a)+var(--b))]</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20011" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20011/hovercard">#20011</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/106017343/v4.2.3</id>
    <updated>2026-04-20T20:46:46Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/releases/tag/v4.2.3"/>
    <title>v4.2.3</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Canonicalization: improve canonicalizations for <code>tracking-*</code> utilities by preferring non-negative utilities (e.g. <code>-tracking-tighter</code> → <code>tracking-wider</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19827" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19827/hovercard">#19827</a>)</li>
<li>Fix crash due to invalid characters in candidate (exceeding valid unicode code point range) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19829" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19829/hovercard">#19829</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure query params in imports are considered unique resources when using <code>@tailwindcss/webpack</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19723" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19723/hovercard">#19723</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: collapse arbitrary values into shorthand utilities (e.g. <code>px-[1.2rem] py-[1.2rem]</code> → <code>p-[1.2rem]</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19837" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19837/hovercard">#19837</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: collapse <code>border-{t,b}-*</code> into <code>border-y-*</code>, <code>border-{l,r}-*</code> into <code>border-x-*</code>, and <code>border-{t,r,b,l}-*</code> into <code>border-*</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19842" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19842/hovercard">#19842</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: collapse <code>scroll-m{t,b}-*</code> into <code>scroll-my-*</code>, <code>scroll-m{l,r}-*</code> into <code>scroll-mx-*</code>, and <code>scroll-m{t,r,b,l}-*</code> into <code>scroll-m-*</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19842" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19842/hovercard">#19842</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: collapse <code>scroll-p{t,b}-*</code> into <code>scroll-py-*</code>, <code>scroll-p{l,r}-*</code> into <code>scroll-px-*</code>, and <code>scroll-p{t,r,b,l}-*</code> into <code>scroll-p-*</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19842" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19842/hovercard">#19842</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: collapse <code>overflow-{x,y}-*</code> into <code>overflow-*</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19842" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19842/hovercard">#19842</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: collapse <code>overscroll-{x,y}-*</code> into <code>overscroll-*</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19842" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19842/hovercard">#19842</a>)</li>
<li>Read from <code>--placeholder-color</code> instead of <code>--background-color</code> for <code>placeholder-*</code> utilities (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19843" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19843/hovercard">#19843</a>)</li>
<li>Upgrade: ensure files are not emptied out when killing the upgrade process while it's running (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19846" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19846/hovercard">#19846</a>)</li>
<li>Upgrade: use <code>config.content</code> when migrating from Tailwind CSS v3 to Tailwind CSS v4 (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19846" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19846/hovercard">#19846</a>)</li>
<li>Upgrade: never migrate files that are ignored by git (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19846" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19846/hovercard">#19846</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>.env</code> and <code>.env.*</code> to default ignored content files (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19846" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19846/hovercard">#19846</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: migrate <code>overflow-ellipsis</code> into <code>text-ellipsis</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19849" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19849/hovercard">#19849</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: migrate <code>start-full</code> → <code>inset-s-full</code>, <code>start-auto</code> → <code>inset-s-auto</code>, <code>start-px</code> → <code>inset-s-px</code>, and <code>start-&lt;number&gt;</code> → <code>inset-s-&lt;number&gt;</code> as well as negative versions (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19849" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19849/hovercard">#19849</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: migrate <code>end-full</code> → <code>inset-e-full</code>, <code>end-auto</code> → <code>inset-e-auto</code>, <code>end-px</code> → <code>inset-e-px</code>, and <code>end-&lt;number&gt;</code> → <code>inset-e-&lt;number&gt;</code> as well as negative versions (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19849" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19849/hovercard">#19849</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: move the <code>-</code> sign inside the arbitrary value <code>-left-[9rem]</code> → <code>left-[-9rem]</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19858" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19858/hovercard">#19858</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: move the <code>-</code> sign outside the arbitrary value <code>ml-[calc(-1*var(--width))]</code> → <code>-ml-(--width)</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19858" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19858/hovercard">#19858</a>)</li>
<li>Improve performance when scanning JSONL / NDJSON files (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19862" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19862/hovercard">#19862</a>)</li>
<li>Support <code>NODE_PATH</code> environment variable in standalone CLI (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19617" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19617/hovercard">#19617</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/106017343/v4.2.2</id>
    <updated>2026-03-18T18:27:26Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/releases/tag/v4.2.2"/>
    <title>v4.2.2</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Added</h3>
<ul>
<li>Support Vite 8 in <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19790" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19790/hovercard">#19790</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Don't crash when candidates contain prototype properties like <code>row-constructor</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19725" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19725/hovercard">#19725</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalize <code>calc(var(--spacing)*…)</code> expressions into <code>--spacing(…)</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19769" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19769/hovercard">#19769</a>)</li>
<li>Fix crash in canonicalization step when handling utilities containing <code>@property</code> at-rules (e.g. <code>shadow-sm border</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19727" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19727/hovercard">#19727</a>)</li>
<li>Skip full reload for server only modules scanned by client CSS when using <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19745" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19745/hovercard">#19745</a>)</li>
<li>Improve canonicalization for bare values exceeding default spacing scale suggestions (e.g. <code>w-1234 h-1234</code> → <code>size-1234</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19809" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19809/hovercard">#19809</a>)</li>
<li>Fix canonicalization resulting in empty list (e.g. <code>w-5 h-5 size-5</code> → <code>''</code> instead of <code>size-5</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19812" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19812/hovercard">#19812</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/106017343/v4.2.1</id>
    <updated>2026-02-23T12:51:32Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/releases/tag/v4.2.1"/>
    <title>v4.2.1</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Allow trailing dash in functional utility names for backwards compatibility (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19696" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19696/hovercard">#19696</a>)</li>
<li>Properly detect classes containing <code>.</code> characters within curly braces in MDX files (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19711" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19711/hovercard">#19711</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/106017343/v4.2.0</id>
    <updated>2026-02-23T12:51:49Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/releases/tag/v4.2.0"/>
    <title>v4.2.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Added</h3>
<ul>
<li>Add mauve, olive, mist, and taupe color palettes to the default theme (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19627" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19627/hovercard">#19627</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>@tailwindcss/webpack</code> package to run Tailwind CSS as a webpack plugin (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19610" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19610/hovercard">#19610</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>pbs-*</code> and <code>pbe-*</code> utilities for <code>padding-block-start</code> and <code>padding-block-end</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19601" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19601/hovercard">#19601</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>mbs-*</code> and <code>mbe-*</code> utilities for <code>margin-block-start</code> and <code>margin-block-end</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19601" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19601/hovercard">#19601</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>scroll-pbs-*</code> and <code>scroll-pbe-*</code> utilities for <code>scroll-padding-block-start</code> and <code>scroll-padding-block-end</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19601" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19601/hovercard">#19601</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>scroll-mbs-*</code> and <code>scroll-mbe-*</code> utilities for <code>scroll-margin-block-start</code> and <code>scroll-margin-block-end</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19601" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19601/hovercard">#19601</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>border-bs-*</code> and <code>border-be-*</code> utilities for <code>border-block-start</code> and <code>border-block-end</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19601" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19601/hovercard">#19601</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>inline-*</code>, <code>min-inline-*</code>, <code>max-inline-*</code> utilities for <code>inline-size</code>, <code>min-inline-size</code>, and <code>max-inline-size</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19612" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19612/hovercard">#19612</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>block-*</code>, <code>min-block-*</code>, <code>max-block-*</code> utilities for <code>block-size</code>, <code>min-block-size</code>, and <code>max-block-size</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19612" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19612/hovercard">#19612</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>inset-s-*</code>, <code>inset-e-*</code>, <code>inset-bs-*</code>, <code>inset-be-*</code> utilities for <code>inset-inline-start</code>, <code>inset-inline-end</code>, <code>inset-block-start</code>, and <code>inset-block-end</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19613" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19613/hovercard">#19613</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>font-features-*</code> utility for <code>font-feature-settings</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19623" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19623/hovercard">#19623</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Prevent double <code>@supports</code> wrapper for <code>color-mix</code> values (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19450" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19450/hovercard">#19450</a>)</li>
<li>Allow whitespace around <code>@source inline()</code> argument (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19461" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19461/hovercard">#19461</a>)</li>
<li>Emit comment when source maps are saved to files when using <code>@tailwindcss/cli</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19447" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19447/hovercard">#19447</a>)</li>
<li>Detect utilities containing capital letters followed by numbers (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19465" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19465/hovercard">#19465</a>)</li>
<li>Fix class extraction for Rails' strict locals (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19525" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19525/hovercard">#19525</a>)</li>
<li>Align <code>@utility</code> name validation with Oxide scanner rules (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19524" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19524/hovercard">#19524</a>)</li>
<li>Fix infinite loop when using <code>@variant</code> inside <code>@custom-variant</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19633" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19633/hovercard">#19633</a>)</li>
<li>Allow multiples of <code>.25</code> in <code>aspect-*</code> fractions (e.g. <code>aspect-8.5/11</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19688" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19688/hovercard">#19688</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure changes to external files listed via <code>@source</code> trigger a full page reload when using <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19670" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19670/hovercard">#19670</a>)</li>
<li>Improve performance of Oxide scanner in bigger projects by reducing file system walks (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19632" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19632/hovercard">#19632</a>)</li>
<li>Ensure import aliases in Astro v5 work without crashing when using <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/issues/19677" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/issues/19677/hovercard">#19677</a>)</li>
<li>Allow escape characters in <code>@utility</code> names to improve support with formatters such as Biome (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19626" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19626/hovercard">#19626</a>)</li>
<li>Fix incorrect canonicalization results when canonicalizing multiple times (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19675" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19675/hovercard">#19675</a>)</li>
<li>Add <code>.jj</code> to default ignored content directories (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19687" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19687/hovercard">#19687</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Deprecated</h3>
<ul>
<li>Deprecate <code>start-*</code> and <code>end-*</code> utilities in favor of <code>inset-s-*</code> and <code>inset-e-*</code> utilities (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19613" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19613/hovercard">#19613</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/106017343/v4.1.18</id>

    <title>v4.1.18</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Fixed</h3>
<ul>
<li>Ensure validation of <code>source(…)</code> happens relative to the file it is in (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19274" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19274/hovercard">#19274</a>)</li>
<li>Include filename and line numbers in CSS parse errors (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19282" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19282/hovercard">#19282</a>)</li>
<li>Skip comments in Ruby files when checking for class names (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19243" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19243/hovercard">#19243</a>)</li>
<li>Skip over arbitrary property utilities with a top-level <code>!</code> in the value (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19243" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19243/hovercard">#19243</a>)</li>
<li>Support environment API in <code>@tailwindcss/vite</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/18970" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/18970/hovercard">#18970</a>)</li>
<li>Preserve case of theme keys from JS configs and plugins (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19337" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19337/hovercard">#19337</a>)</li>
<li>Write source maps correctly on the CLI when using <code>--watch</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19373" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19373/hovercard">#19373</a>)</li>
<li>Handle special defaults (like <code>ringColor.DEFAULT</code>) in JS configs (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19348" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19348/hovercard">#19348</a>)</li>
<li>Improve backwards compatibility for <code>content</code> theme key from JS configs (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19381" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19381/hovercard">#19381</a>)</li>
<li>Upgrade: Handle <code>future</code> and <code>experimental</code> config keys (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19344" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19344/hovercard">#19344</a>)</li>
<li>Try to canonicalize any arbitrary utility to a bare value (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19379" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19379/hovercard">#19379</a>)</li>
<li>Validate candidates similarly to Oxide (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19397" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19397/hovercard">#19397</a>)</li>
<li>Canonicalization: combine <code>text-*</code> and <code>leading-*</code> classes (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19396" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19396/hovercard">#19396</a>)</li>
<li>Correctly handle duplicate CLI arguments (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19416" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19416/hovercard">#19416</a>)</li>
<li>Don’t emit color-mix fallback rules inside <code>@keyframes</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19419" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19419/hovercard">#19419</a>)</li>
<li>CLI: Don't hang when output is <code>/dev/stdout</code> (<a href="https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19421" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/19421/hovercard">#19421</a>)</li>
</ul></content>
